function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file at the specified path. Use this to examine source code, configuration files, or any text file.

path.description: The relative or absolute path to the file to read

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List files and folders in a directory. Use this to explore project structure and find relevant files.

path.description: The directory path to list. Defaults to current working directory if not specified.

recursive.description: If true, list contents recursively. Defaults to false.

function.name: search_directory
function.description: Search for a text pattern across files in a directory. Returns matching files with line numbers and content. Use this to find where functions, variables, or strings are used.

pattern.description: The text or regex pattern to search for

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to current working directory.

filePattern.description: Glob pattern to filter files, e.g. '*.js' or '*.ts'. Defaults to all files.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit an EXISTING file by replacing specific text. Use this for updates/modifications to files that already exist. Always use the full path from search results. Read the file first to ensure accurate matching.

path.description: The path to the file to edit

old_text.description: The exact text to find and replace. Must match exactly including whitespace.

new_text.description: The text to replace it with

dry_run.description: If true, preview the change without applying it. Defaults to false.

replace_all.description: If true, replace all occurrences of old_text in the file. Defaults to false (requires unique match).

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create a NEW file. Use this only for creating files that don't exist. For modifying existing files, use edit_file instead. Always use full paths.

path.description: The path where the file should be created

content.description: The content to write to the file

overwrite.description: If true, overwrite existing file. If false, fail if file exists. Defaults to false.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a shell command. Use this to run build tools, tests, git commands, etc. Requires user permission.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000 (30 seconds).
